program_name: Doctor of Philosophy in Islamic Studies

fees.notes: Official UIS international fee for Ijazah Doktor Falsafah Islamiyyat (Doctor of Philosophy in Islamiyyat) (programme code pi01), last published on study.uis.edu.my (capture 20240710095115): RM18,890 total, an all-inclusive package covering registration, facilities & welfare, tuition & assessment, accommodation (Dormitory D, full-time only) and graduation. UIS's current programme page (https://study.uis.edu.my/pi01, accessed 2026-09-18) says tuition fee information will be updated soon, so this is the latest officially published international figure. fees.per_year = total / official duration.
